record.oneLiner: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support software and helpdesk platform featuring a robust REST API for ticketing, contacts, and knowledge base management.
record.verdictReason: Freshdesk provides a comprehensive REST API that can be accessed immediately using an API key obtained on a self-serve basis via profile settings on any active plan. Community MCP servers are also available.

evidence.quote: You can use your personal API key to authenticate the request. If you use the API key, there is no need for a password. You can use any set of characters as a dummy password.
To find your API key:. 2. Click on your profile picture on the top right and select Profile Settings. 3. On the right pane, click on the View API key option and complete the captcha verification.
+ Create a Ticket  /api/v2/tickets. + Create an Outbound Email  /api/v2/tickets/outbound_email.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for the Freshdesk API. Designed for use with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and other MCP clients.
